text: After his wife Theresa's mastectomy, Nathan Gardner [moves the family to his late father's farm|trigger|making a new home] outside Arkham, and one night a brilliantly coloured meteorite lands by the well. The groundwater takes an oily sheen, strange plants and insects bloom, young Jack talks to a friend inside the well, and Theresa calmly cuts off two fingers while making dinner. As time slips and tempers flare, [the Color fuses mother and son into one mass|images|wounded and changing bodies], [draining the life from everything it touches|wants|feeding on the living] and [bending the farm out of shape|rules|reality comes apart].
